note: Third-party pages about the event, each fetched, frozen and hashed like any other source. Linked to, never reproduced: 'what_it_says' is this publication's own summary after reading the frozen copy. A page that did not resolve is listed under 'excluded' with the reason, and cannot be cited.

items.what_it_says: Announces applications for a 48-hour non-stop startup pitch marathon run alongside the summit on 16–17 September 2026, as an official Guinness World Records attempt, with almost a thousand founders taking part remotely or in person at Unicorn Factory Lisboa's Beato Innovation District.
items.title: Startup Summit Lisbon Opens Applications for 48hr Pitch Marathon

items.what_it_says: Reports the same Guinness World Records attempt: a 48-hour pitch marathon with almost 1,000 startups pitching, founders participating remotely or in person. Its summary line dates the marathon to 17 September and its body to 16–17 September; both are on the same page.
items.title: Startup Summit Lisbon will officially attempt to set a Guinness World Record

items.what_it_says: An event listing by the Porto scale-up body: dates 17–18 September, venue Beato Innovation District with the street address, and a description of the summit as a large-scale founder, investor and corporate conference.
items.title: Startup Summit Lisbon 2026 | ScaleUp Porto

items.what_it_says: A calendar listing carrying the event's own framing — 2,000+ target attendees, 150+ speakers, 200+ booths — with start and end times (17 September 07:30 to 18 September 17:45) and a calendar export.
items.title: Startup Summit Lisbon 2026 — StartupEvents.org

items.what_it_says: A dates-venue-guide page: 17–18 September 2026 at Unicorn Factory, Beato Innovation District, with the street address.
items.title: Startup Summit Lisbon 2026 (September 2026, Lisbon, Portugal) – Dates, Venue & Guide | Startup Map Hub

items.what_it_says: The ticketing listing: 17–18 September, 09:30 to midnight, Unicorn Factory Lisboa. Its agenda widget carries tabs for 16, 17, 18 AND 19 September, with the Welcome Drinks on the 16th from 19:00 to 22:00. The event's own site names no 19 September activity.
items.title: Startup Summit Lisbon 2026 | Founder, Startup & Investor Event Tickets, Thursday, September 17-Friday, September 18 • 9:30 AM-12 AM | Eventb

items.what_it_says: The event's own guide to Lisbon tech events in 2026, positioning the summit among them: 17–18 September at Beato, 200+ booths.
items.title: Lisbon Tech Events 2026 — Founder & Investor Guide
